title: Stop!! Hibari-kun!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After his mother dies, Kohsaku Sakamoto moves in with yakuza boss Ibari Ozora and his children, including Hibari, the popular, stylish girl at school whom the family knows was assigned male (Peow2 blurb; ANN). A 1980s shonen gag romantic comedy, it plays Hibari's pursuit of Kohsaku and the household's yakuza life for slapstick (ANN). Four volumes, the series was left unfinished (MU).
life_message: Hibari lives as herself without apology, though the comedy around her mostly laughs rather than reflects.

folkways.japan: The series is a product of 1980s Japanese gag manga, where gender-play comedy and yakuza family parody were common genre conventions.

delivery.evidence: ANN reviewers describe a gag manga 'so very much of its time', with no stated message.

personified.ideology: Rejection of his child's gender presentation

delivery.note: Reviewers say Hibari is persistently misgendered and the transphobic father is played for comedy; no position is argued.

winners_losers: Hibari stays herself and is the comic star; the father's anger is the running gag. Reviewers find the humor dated and often at trans and gay people's expense.
